resources.string: Which SIM the message must arrive on.
“Same SIM” sends the forward from the SIM the message arrived on. A SIM without credit cannot send.
Off: sign-in and verification codes are never forwarded.
On: codes are forwarded too. Only use this for your own devices, a code gives access to an account.
